referee_caveats_inferred: Only six systems, so Spearman coefficients (and the p-values, not given) are weak statistical evidence
Diffuse emission is a residual of aperture-extracted fluxes, dependent on aperture and 2-sigma contour choices and on the single 0.58 PSF correction
Simulated carbon fraction (about 59%) differs from observed [CII] fraction (about 25%), and the sim vs obs trend with distance disagrees until restricted to r_m < 16 kpc
Cold carbon mass is not equivalent to [CII] luminosity (no radiative transfer, no sensitivity effects)

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Six ALPINE fields, calibrated visibilities or cubes: probably a few to tens of GB
reproducibility.score_reason: Data come from a named ALMA large program, but imaging and fitting parameters are incomplete, the simulation data are only available on request, and the individual per-system numbers are given mostly in figures.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The simulation half cannot be reproduced without author data, and the observational recipe lacks key settings, with results mostly given as correlation coefficients.
